NiDX9Renderer camera/viewport setup. Builds and uploads view/projection matrices, then converts the normalized viewport to pixel coordinates from the current render-target dimensions.

Build and upload camera view/projection state, convert a normalized viewport against current target dimensions, and call IDirect3DDevice9::SetViewport. This function does not set a scissor rectangle or alter D3DRS_SCISSORTESTENABLE.
GPU camera decode: camera position becomes separate B3F92C origin; view translation uses B3F9A8..B3F9B0, normally zero. Perspective extents are slopes. Frustum sums/differences and reciprocal depth are stored as float before projection arithmetic. Viewport conversion truncates extended-precision expressions; no half-pixel correction is included here.
